messages:
maya_partnerships: Quick sync — we need a compact Quickstart Kit for CloudX marketplace partners. Goal: 1-click deploy + terraform module + sample app. Keep it minimal for partners to self-onboard. Thoughts? :eyes:

jordan_infra: Agree. Suggest two flavors: managed-backend (managed DB) and self-hosted (PVC). Also include an optional metrics export block for partners that want telemetry.

sam_dev: Prototype repo pushed: gitlab.com/redwood/marketplace/cloudx-quickstart (branch: demo/compact). It has a demo app, helm chart, and basic module layout. Link in repo README.

maya_partnerships: @sam_dev can you add an "enable_metrics" var so partners can opt-in? Legal flagged telemetry opt-in requirement.

sam_dev: will add. quick snippet I'll include in module variables:
```hcl
variable "enable_metrics" {
  type = bool
  default = false
}
```

nora_fieldeng: For on-prem/distributor partners we need arm64 images and a minimal k8s manifest (no cloud-specific storage). I'll add image variants + nodeSelector.

deploy-bot: Pipeline triggered: cloudx-quickstart/branch demo/compact · #42 — smoke tests queued :rocket:

maya_partnerships: For the CloudX marketplace listing we must produce a single-click template using their schema. @jordan_infra can you map our module vars to the marketplace params?

jordan_infra: Yep. I'll create a mapping file and add a compatibility table in README for instance types (CPU/GPU) and recommended SKUs. Also will auto-generate a one-click manifest via a small script.

sam_dev: Heads-up: writing an integration test that boots the quickstart in a tiny staging account and runs smoke checks (startup, healthcheck, inference sanity). Target PR by tomorrow.

nora_fieldeng: We'll also want a partner onboarding checklist in the repo: docs, terraform module, helm chart, e2e smoke script, license, and security scan output. I'll draft it.

maya_partnerships: Nice. Let's do an internal technical review Thurs 10am PT. Please surface blockers by Wed EOD. :calendar: @all

jordan_infra: Invite sent.

sam_dev: Added QA ticket for flaky smoke (#1234), will link test logs in PR.

maya_partnerships: Thanks team — focus on making the default path the simplest possible for partners. We can add advanced options later. :clap:
